ContentFellow FAQ: prices, trials and how it works

Straight answers about ContentFellow's monthly marketing plans for UK small businesses.

Pricing

How much does ContentFellow cost?

Plans start at £59 a month. Social Fellow £59 or £129, Build Fellow £69, Search Fellow £89, Creator Fellow £119, Studio Fellow £149, or the Growth Fellow (all five) £389 a month.

Is there a contract?

No long contract. Billing is monthly and you can add, remove or upgrade Fellows from the next month.

Is there a free trial?

Yes, every Fellow: 7 free days for Search, Social and Growth, 3 free videos for Creator, a free mini shoot for Studio, and a free homepage preview for Build. No card needed.

Are prices plus VAT?

No. ContentFellow is not currently VAT registered, so the price shown is the full monthly amount you pay, with no VAT added.

SEO & GEO

Can you get my business recommended by ChatGPT?

Nobody can guarantee it, but the Search Fellow does what AI assistants rely on: Bing indexing, structured data, answer-first service pages, consistent directory listings, reviews and tracking which prompts name you.

What is GEO?

GEO (generative engine optimisation) makes your business easy for AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity to find, understand and recommend.

What's the most affordable SEO for a UK small business?

Affordable UK SEO typically costs £89 to £400 a month. The Search Fellow is £89 a month and covers SEO and GEO together.

How long does SEO take?

Technical fixes show within weeks; rankings and AI mentions usually build over 6 to 12 weeks or longer in competitive areas.

Websites

How much is a website with ContentFellow?

The Build Fellow is £69 a month with no upfront fee: a custom site up to five pages, hosting, security, updates and two change requests a month.

Can I see my website before paying?

Yes. We design a free homepage preview within 3 working days.

Social media

How much is social media management?

The Social Fellow is £59 a month (Manage: up to 2 platforms, weekday replies, ad set-up) or £129 a month (Manage + Post: up to 3 platforms with daily posting and trend research).

Do I approve posts?

Yes, every post is shared with you for approval before it goes live.

Video & photo

How much is a monthly photo and video shoot?

The Studio Fellow is £149 a month: one on-site shoot up to 3 hours, photo and 4K video, 20 edited photos within 5 working days.

How much is video editing for Reels and TikTok?

The Creator Fellow is £119 a month: 8 short videos, 1 motion graphics video and 1 podcast edit up to 60 minutes.

Where do you shoot?

On-site at your business within about 20 miles of Burnley, Lancashire (Padiham, Nelson, Colne, Accrington, Clitheroe, Blackburn and nearby). Editing and other services are UK-wide.

Getting started

How do I start?

Fill in the 2-minute form at contentfellow.com/get-started/ and choose a free trial or the free AI visibility check. We reply within 1 working day.

Who is ContentFellow for?

UK small businesses and creators who want professional marketing on a small, predictable monthly budget.

Free AI visibility check

We ask ChatGPT and Gemini 10 questions your customers ask, and email you who they recommend instead of you, plus the 3 fixes that matter most. Free, within 2 working days.
